channel.title: Send codes by
channel.description: The channel Notifications sends the code on (its template accounts.phone_code).

defaultCallingCode.title: Default calling code
defaultCallingCode.description: For numbers typed without a country code, for example +92 or +1. Empty: numbers must start with + or 00.

trunkPrefix.title: National trunk prefix
trunkPrefix.description: Dropped from national numbers before the calling code is added, for example 0.
